limits.git_lfs_payloads: only reachable pointer blobs; external LFS content is not fetched
limits.reachable_scope: local objects reachable from refs/HEAD via git rev-list --objects --all
limits.remote_unfetched_history: not available without fetch; not scanned
limits.submodule_payloads: gitlinks are present in trees; nested repositories are not traversed
limits.unfetched_objects: no fetch; GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1; missing reachable objects fail the scan
limits.unknown_values: no claim; only supplied strings and their supported encodings are searched
